concurrency.description: Limit how many tasks can run simultaneously. Once the limit is reached, new tasks queue in creation order and start automatically as slots free up.

createTask.fillRequired: Please fill in the description and goal
createTask.title: New task
createTask.description: Fill in the test target and goal; advanced parameters can be expanded as needed.
createTask.namePlaceholder: A recognizable name for the task, e.g. Acme website penetration test
createTask.categoryDescription: Optional, single category; used for task list filtering and archiving, never affecting agent execution.
createTask.descriptionPlaceholder: Test target and background, e.g. test the example.com site
createTask.uploadedCount: {count} files uploaded; their absolute paths were appended to the end of the description (editable)
createTask.uploadHint: Multi-select; after upload, absolute file paths are appended to the description for the worker to open with Read/Bash
createTask.goalPlaceholder: What to achieve, e.g. gain admin panel access or server privileges
createTask.linkedTasksDescription: Link up to {count} tasks. Live, read-only inheritance of the selected tasks' persistent blackboards, asset scope, and related traffic; the new task writes to its own blackboard.
createTask.companyScopeDescription: On task creation, the selected companies' current assets are added to "Test assets", and their domains, IPs, CIDRs, ICPs, and company keywords are provided to the agent as scope context; no intents are generated automatically and execution goals are not forced to change.
createTask.interceptRulesDescription: Applies to this task only and is not written to global rules. Evaluation order: "Block" rules (including global ones) match first, and a hit forbids testing; with no hit and "Allow" rules configured for this task, an asset must match an allow rule to be permitted, otherwise testing is likewise forbidden; with no allow rules configured, no whitelist is active.
createTask.llmChainDescription: Reorder profiles to choose worker rotation order or failover priority. Saving the chain resets exhausted profiles.
createTask.credentialsDescription: Test accounts reused by the agent for authenticated testing. Leave the password empty to have the agent register that account itself and record the password it chose. Use dedicated test accounts only — anything declared here is sent to the configured LLM provider during the task.
createTask.timeoutHint: When the time is up, a graceful wind-down is triggered (each agent writes back + the planner makes the final verdict) and the task enters the timeout terminal state.
createTask.heartbeatHint: When this much time has passed since the last planning round ended or the task started, with no triggers in between, a planning round fires automatically (deadlock backstop + wakes supervision of running workers). Minimum 10 minutes.
createTask.seedFirstIntentLabel: Dispatch the first intent directly (description + goal)
createTask.seedFirstIntentHint: When enabled, the "description + goal" is dispatched as one intent right at creation; the worker starts without waiting for the first planning round and the planner takes over afterwards to judge/follow up. Recommended for settings like CTF where one run usually solves it directly; disabled follows the standard plan-then-execute flow.
createTask.coverageHint: On by default: computes and displays test coverage, shows testing progress on the situational graph, and automatically accumulates the test scope. When off, coverage is no longer computed or displayed, the situational graph shows assets without progress, and agents no longer receive scope-related tools. Disabling does not affect "Linked company asset scope".
